title: Green synthesis of Cu2S using garlic-derived sulfur: structural, morphological, optical, electrical, and photoresponse characterization with potential for thermoelectric applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,3406-3415
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07771G, Paper

M. M. Shahidi, M. Akbari, M. Mehrabani, A. Shams Khameneh, G. G. Welegergs, M. Aligholami, M. Maaza
This study presents a green synthesis of Cu2S thin films using garlic-derived sulfur at room temperature. The films exhibit unique properties, showing their potential for optoelectronic and thermoelectric applications.
